title: AYO WTF?!
blurb: An emergency brake for a conversation that has abruptly gone somewhere it should not. This is shock and accusation delivered together in one syllable cluster — the point is not merely that something surprising was said, but that it needs reviewing immediately and in front of everybody present. Play it when the group chat turns, when song lyrics are properly heard for the first time after years of singing them, or when a plot twist arrives with no warning. Constitutionally protected reaction audio, and long may it remain so.
